communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

For the 1,524 identifiers in the attached FAERS case list, please provide the most current releasable consolidated individual case report, including the complete clinical narrative and follow-up narrative information, whether incorporated into the consolidated report or maintained separately.

These cases were identified through FDA’s openFDA drug adverse-event API. They were first received during 2015–2025 and identify hydroxyprogesterone caproate as a suspect drug. The accompanying reference file identifies the matching terms and source identifiers.

My initial priority is the consolidated case reports and complete narrative information. 

Please preserve releasable clinical details, including treatment indication, dose, route, treatment dates, medication-error circumstances, gestational age and exposure timing, event chronology, relevant medical history, concomitant medications, and maternal, fetal, pregnancy, and neonatal outcomes.

I understand that personal identifiers and other exempt information may require redaction. Please release reasonably segregable nonexempt information and identify the applicable exemption for any withholding.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Emma Yasinski
